attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 16
attributes.name: Bound Ophidian Demon
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to roll 6d6+6 and add the Slashing trait. Characters may not play other cards or use powers on this check.

Bury this card to add 6 to your combat check.

After playing this card, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 18 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.

If this card is in your hand, you may treat it as a monster.
